item.title: The AI Honeymoon Period: What Context Engineering Taught Me About Hype vs Reality
item.description: A Twitter debate about AI's transformative potential reveals the gap between honeymoon-period optimism and measured reality. Why agile methodology and product managers might be the real winners in this AI transition.
